st_ciel.name: Allée des Averses
st_ciel.alt: A path winding through green park fields under a huge rainbow, with swallows in the sky, a wooden fence, a stream, a cabbage patch and a picnic table, and four little round painted doors in the distance: yellow in a grassy mound, green in a hedge, red in a haystack, blue in a stone wall. Monsieur Verbe stands under his umbrella as a little cloud rains on him, in a gold beret; plants a sapling; watches his paper boat float down the stream; and snatches his hand back from a steaming pie. The circus tent at the top left leads back to the park.

soleil.name: Pré Ensoleillé
soleil.alt: A sunny corner of the park fields under a smiling sun, with a whitewashed cottage with blue shutters, a blossom tree, an old street lamp and a dark hollow under the hedge: Monsieur Verbe peers into the hollow at a black cat's gleaming eyes in a gold beret; beams up at the sun in his sunglasses; flings open the shutters to the sunshine; pulls the chain to relight the street lamp; and sponges the last gray cloud out of the sky in a green beret. The round yellow door in the grassy mound leads back.

doors.label: Allée des Averses
doors.hint: Back through the round yellow door

jardiniers.name: Potager des Jardiniers
jardiniers.alt: A walled kitchen garden in the park fields, with rows of young lettuces, a rose bush in full bloom, a little cherry tree, a potting bench and a faint rainbow: Monsieur Verbe polishes a silver teapot on his crate in a green beret; paints a wheelbarrow gold; hoes the lettuces; smiles into his hand mirror beside the roses in a green beret; throws up his hands at a nibbled lettuce as a rabbit hops by; and hugs his little cherry tree in a green beret. The round green door in the hedge leads back.

doors.label: Allée des Averses
doors.hint: Back through the round green door

moissons.name: Champ des Moissonneurs
moissons.alt: A golden harvest field at the edge of the park, with hay bales, a tomato patch, a sprinkler, an eagle gliding overhead and autumn leaves drifting: Monsieur Verbe gapes at a flower box bursting into bloom in a green beret; stares at a coffee stain on his white apron; stands dripping in the sprinkler's spray; spreads his arms to glide like the eagle; and leafs through a big book on a hay bale as leaves flutter out. The round red door in the haystack leads back.

doors.label: Allée des Averses
doors.hint: Back through the round red door in the haystack

inondations.name: Prairie des Inondations
inondations.alt: A riverside meadow in the park after heavy rain, with the river spilling into a vegetable patch where ducks swim, a wooden hen house, a washing line, a rain barrel and a rainbow: Monsieur Verbe tucks a knitted blanket over a hen on her eggs; rows his little boat down the river; wades knee-deep in his flooded vegetable patch among the ducks; winds a long red scarf round and round his neck; shakes out a patchwork quilt in the breeze; and gapes as the rain barrel overflows. The round blue door in the stone wall leads back.

doors.label: Allée des Averses
doors.hint: Back through the round blue door in the stone wall
